addresses_agent.instructions: Is any part of this text addressed to an AI assistant or AI agent that is reading it?

criteria.true: Some part of the text speaks directly to an AI assistant or AI agent that reads it.
criteria.false: The text speaks only to human readers, or to no reader in particular.

requests_action.instructions: Does this text tell the one reading it to take an action, such as running a command, changing or deleting files, sending data somewhere, or opening a link?

criteria.true: The text tells its reader to take an action.
criteria.false: The text describes or explains without telling its reader to take an action.

stance.instructions: How does this text relate to instructions for an AI agent?

criteria.informs: The text gives information and contains no instructions for an AI agent.
criteria.discusses_instructions: The text describes, quotes or analyses instructions or prompts for AI systems without telling the AI agent reading it to follow them.
criteria.instructs_reader: The text tells the AI agent reading it to do something.
